Woman Kills Mother-in-Law, Attacks Own Children in Separate Incidents

In separate incidents, a woman in Uttar Pradesh allegedly killed her mother-in-law after an argument, while another woman in Andhra Pradesh is reported to have killed her two young daughters before attempting suicide. Preliminary inquiries in the Andhra Pradesh case suggest domestic disputes as a possible motive. The knife used in the Uttar Pradesh incident was recovered.
